visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, dressed in a white sleeveless tank top and denim shorts, sits on a white elevated ledge next to a large window with horizontal blinds. A white cat sits to her left. She holds a long wand-style cat toy with a dark handle. The room is brightly lit by soft daylight filtered through the blinds. (2) The woman waves the cat toy in front of the white cat. The cat watches intently and raises its right paw to bat at the wand. She smiles while maintaining eye contact with the pet. (3) She continues to move the wand in small circles. The cat shifts its weight, looking up at the dangling end of the toy. A white plush pillow is visible on the ledge behind the cat. (4) The woman moves the wand behind the cat's back, causing the cat to turn its head and torso to follow the motion. She looks directly at the camera with a playful smile. (5) She lowers the wand toward the ledge surface. The cat remains focused on the toy, occasionally pawing at it. The woman continues the interaction, her movements calm and steady.
